It is Tuesday, April 28, 2026. Here are today's major global and regional news headlines:

King Charles III Addresses Congress: On the second day of his historic four-day state visit to the U.S., King Charles III is scheduled to address a joint session of Congress today, focusing on the "deep bond" between the UK and U.S. amid shifting global alliances.  
White House Shooting Aftermath: Following the arraignment of Cole Tomas Allen, 31, for the attempted assassination of President Trump at the White House Correspondents’ Dinner on Saturday, federal authorities are expanding their investigation into potential domestic extremist links in California and Illinois.

Hormuz Crisis Diplomacy: While a temporary ceasefire has allowed some commercial traffic to resume through the Strait of Hormuz, regional governments (including Laos and Indonesia) are implementing emergency measures today to curb inflation and rising transport costs triggered by the two-month blockade.

Mali Insurgency: Security across the Sahel remains on high alert following the death of a senior military official in Mali, as coordinated attacks by northern separatist groups continue to destabilize the transition government.

Canada’s Economic Update: Prime Minister Justin Trudeau is set to table the 2026 Spring Economic Update in the House of Commons this afternoon, with Finance Minister François-Philippe Champagne expected to focus on housing affordability and national defense spending. 
 
IMF Growth Revision: The International Monetary Fund has officially lowered its global growth forecast for 2026 to 3.1%, citing the "dual blockade" in West Asia as the largest disruption to the world energy market since the 1970s.  

ASEAN Climate Week: The Philippines officially hosts ASEAN Climate Week 2026 today, with member states meeting in Manila to translate regional climate commitments into actionable, local policies for disaster-prone areas.

Biofuel Push: Indonesia has accelerated its transition to B50 biodiesel and E20 bioethanol as part of a national strategy to achieve energy self-sufficiency and mitigate the impact of high global oil prices.  

AI Brain Health Monitoring: NTT DATA has launched a first of its kind brain health monitoring service for commercial drivers today. The AI driven system analyzes driving patterns to generate "brain health scores," aimed at extending the career longevity of aging taxi and truck drivers.  

Chemical Industry Innovation: Clariant unveiled CATOFIN 1000 today, a next generation catalyst designed to significantly reduce carbon fouling and increase productivity in the global propylene market.

Space Exploration Progress: Reports from the Extremely Large Telescope (ELT) construction site in Chile indicate that the facility remains on track for late 2026 completion, promising to capture images of distant exoplanets with unprecedented clarity.
Regional Briefs

Indonesia Train Crash: A major evacuation is underway in Bekasi following a collision between a CommuterLine train and a diesel train late Monday; dozens are reported injured.  

Laos Tourism Initiative: The government has announced a new "Southern Tourism Circuit" linking Laos with Vietnam and Cambodia to boost regional travel and stabilize the local currency.  

Space Weather Alert: Scientists have issued a warning for minor geomagnetic storm activity today, which may cause brief interruptions to satellite-based communication systems in northern latitudes.
